caption: The drawing depicts four views of a brass or gold-colored metal candlestick holder with a round, shallow base and a cylindrical socket for holding a candle. The topmost view shows the candlestick fully assembled from a slightly elevated angle. The two middle views present the candlestick partially disassembled, with the cylindrical socket section separated from the base and placed on its side, revealing a threaded screw used for attachment. The bottommost view displays the base of the holder inverted, showing its smooth, slightly recessed bottom surface. The objects have a metallic sheen and the drawing is rendered on a cream or light tan background, with some orange-brown stains or marks visible, particularly in the upper right corner. There is a fine rectangular border enclosing the entire composition.
title: Candlestick
